name: archistrator-uitests
description: Generated scenario tests for the archistrator SPA's client components (deterministic component testing). testgen emits generated/<component>/{<scenario>.spec.gen.ts,playwright.config.gen.ts,reporter.gen.ts} from the committed per-component test plan, plus a once-emitted hooks.ts the construction agent fills; nothing here is hand-written.

scripts.test:scenarios: set -e; for c in generated/*/playwright.config.gen.ts; do playwright test -c "$c"; done
